items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: I said, Joe, what happened? I said, Joe, wait, wait. Watch your, watch some water. You eat all that meat like that.

ctx.x: I tell you. Yeah, he had one.

One. They didn't like that. Yeah, but there was one. One. His daughter said one too. He was playing? Yeah. He used to cook me all the time. He said two, three times a week. He said, well, I'm going to the hospital. He said, I'll get an operator on. He said, I had a company that he used to leave in a while of eating. He used to eat a while. He had a while of ground meat. Like that. That wasn't bought. And he got his going home and cooked. I said, Joe, what happened? I said, Joe, wait, wait. Watch your, watch some…
Somebody said he used to have a wagon and sell, was it sandwiches or cakes or something?
